title: Rabbi Abba son of Rav Yosef bar Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 141a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.141a.8), where he spoke to Rav Kahana (Rav Ashi’s teacher). Hyman identifies this Rabbi Abba as the grandson of “Rava.” See the entry Rava son of Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara has Rabbi Abba son of Rav Yosef bar Rava questioning Rav Kahana about the command to release a mother bird. The relationship to Rav Ashi and the emphasis on Abba’s grandfather are Hyman’s.
